Notes: Old Geezer (OLGE), Arrival hall (4604) at (189.0, 1.0, 187.9). Rebuilt from 1 QuestDialogCapture dump (Old_Geezer_OLGE, 2026-10-20, character Soldaman, no quest state).

work_omni.Text: So I should work for Omni-Tek?

listen.Text: Listen to me young friend. Omni-Tek has provided for us and created something real and substantial on this world. Everybody here should be grateful for what the Corporation has done for us. Those clanners are a bunch of ungrateful whiners, and only our fierce loyalty and obedience to the Corporation will help destroy the rebel menace.

doing_here.Text: Just watching the new arrivals, making sure they know the truth about them filthy clanners.  I like to talk to fresh colonists like yourself.  Gives me something to do besides sitting at home.

Text: If you have the decency to be grateful for what Omni-Tek has done for us all here on Rubi-Ka, you absolutely should.
{delay 5}\n\nI know many has chosen to join the Jobe research program in the past, but right now Omni-Tek is fighting aliens to ensure your safety!
{delay 1}\nWith proper training, you can help them fight off these invaders that attack our cities and destroy our notum mines.\n
{delay 1}Resourceful people are always appreciated and cared for in the corporation.
